KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Enchanted Night Garden

A moonlit garden glows under a starry indigo sky, a round golden moon centred between two dark trees whose branches are dotted with amber fruit like lanterns, a pale villa tucked among the deep foliage below. Layered emerald and teal greens fill the scene, lit by orange marigolds and soft white blooms in the undergrowth, in a dreamy, decorative folk style that is dense and immersive yet calm. The moon and house sit high-centre, so scaling keeps them anchored near the top while the flowering base extends; position a low headboard or console so the moon and villa are not covered. A gentle fit for a bedroom, nursery or kids' room. Each panel prints as one continuous scene, not a repeated pattern, and the painterly finish is shown off best on Soft Matte stock.
